title: Moore
creator: CrossFit
description: A 20-minute AMRAP of one rope climb, a 400 m run and a max set of handstand push-ups; score is total HSPU reps. Honours Officer David S. Moore of the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department, shot during a traffic stop in 2011. Each max set ends the moment you come off the wall, so pace the first ones.
